title: Certificate Installation Service Fees
content:
Harborline support can install a certificate of SSL/TLS Certificates for the customer. This fee sheet records, for each Harborline certificate product, the fee for installation by Harborline support on a server not hosted by Harborline, whether installation on a Harborline hosting plan is free and automatic, and whether the installation fee is refunded when the installation was never performed.

| Certificate product | Fee for installation by Harborline support on a server not hosted by Harborline (USD) | Installation on a Harborline hosting plan free and automatic | Installation fee refunded when the installation was never performed |
|---|---|---|---|
| Harborline DV Single Domain | 24.99 | Yes | Yes |
| Harborline DV Multi-Domain | 24.99 | Yes | Yes |
| Harborline DV Wildcard | 24.99 | Yes | Yes |
| Harborline OV Single Domain | 0.00 | Yes | Yes |
| Harborline OV Wildcard | 0.00 | Yes | Yes |
| Harborline EV Single Domain | 0.00 | Yes | Yes |
| Harborline EV Multi-Domain | 0.00 | Yes | Yes |

## Reading the fee sheet

| Where the certificate is installed | Product | Figure on this sheet |
|---|---|---|
| A Harborline hosting plan | any | free and automatic |
| A server not hosted by Harborline | Harborline DV Single Domain, Harborline DV Multi-Domain, Harborline DV Wildcard | installation fee 24.99 |
| A server not hosted by Harborline | Harborline OV Single Domain, Harborline OV Wildcard, Harborline EV Single Domain, Harborline EV Multi-Domain | installation fee 0.00 |

**Is an installation fee kept when the installation never took place?** No. For every product the installation fee is refunded when the installation was never performed.
